Prefer uppercase Issue-prefix identifiers in tracker and MCP (#146)

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: fewensa-23
  description: |-
    Wire the shared Issue-reference resolver into tracker get and search so helixbox-9112, HBX-9112, hbx-9112, and mixed-case prefix forms resolve to one IssueId while preserving Profile and Workspace isolation.
    
    New create, mutation, detail, list, and search projections render preferred `{ISSUE_PREFIX}-{number}` without rewriting stored identifiers. Exact identifier search ranks preferred and legacy forms first. MCP get accepts those forms, rejects malformed syntax as invalid arguments, and maps unknown or workspace-mismatch references as not found. UUID-only mutation schemas stay UUID-only.
    
    Also renumber the workspace-alias migration to 0113 so it no longer collides with landing-capability 0111.
